Card Q&A.a: No, Digi-Egg cards aren't Digimon cards, so they can't be played with this effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to play a Digi-Egg in its digivolution cards to my battle area?

Card Q&A.a: No, it's treated as a separate Digimon, and enters play unsuspended.
Card Q&A.q: I suspend this card as I declare its attack. If I use its effect to play a Digimon card from its digivolution cards, does that Digimon enter play suspended?

Card Q&A.a: No, it's treated as a separate Digimon, and doesn't receive any effects that currently apply to the original Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's effect to play a Digimon card from its digivolution cards, does that Digimon carry over any effects currently applied to this Digimon?
If I use this card's effect to play a Digimon card with an [On Play] effect, does that effect activate as the Digimon enters play?

Card Q&A.a: It activates immediately after the card enters play. Even if there are other [When Attacking] and "when one of your Digimon attacks" effects waiting to be activated, the [On Play] effect was just triggered, so it activates first.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's effect to play a Digimon card with an [On Play] effect, when does that effect activate?

Card Q&A.a: No, it's considered to have just entered play, so it can't attack.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card's effect to play a Digimon card. Can it attack this turn?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, as long as you are able to.
Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon has a level 4 or lower Digimon card in its digivolution cards, do I have to activate this card's effect?

Effect: [When Attacking] Play 1 level 4 or lower digivolution card under this card as another Digimon without paying its memory cost.
